title: Algeria national and wilaya boundaries (69 wilayas, OSM snapshot)
title_fr: Limites nationales et des wilayas de l'Algérie (69 wilayas, instantané OSM)
title_ar: حدود الجزائر الوطنية وحدود الولايات (69 ولاية، لقطة من OpenStreetMap)
description: Polygons for Algeria's national territory and its 69 wilayas, extracted from OpenStreetMap on 19 November 2026, assembled, clipped to land and checked for overlaps by AEO. The 69-wilaya configuration was established by Loi n° 26-06 of 4 April 2026 (JO n° 25); wilayas 59–69 were named by Décret présidentiel n° 26-206 (JO n° 40).
purpose: A versioned, openly licensed reference geography for summarising gridded data by wilaya, for the AEO map explorer, and for future wilaya-level search and downloads.
creator: Algeria Earth Observatory maintainers

spatial_extent.description: All of Algeria; land area only (territorial sea removed).

processing: Boundary relations (admin_level 2 for Algeria and admin_level 4 within it) were downloaded from the Overpass API with member-way geometries. Rings were assembled with shapely.polygonize, clipped to land using the OSM-derived geoBoundaries DZA ADM0 polygon as a coastline mask, and repaired. One overlap left by an incomplete OSM edit (El Aricha, 63, still included in Tlemcen, 13) was resolved by giving precedence to the newer wilaya. A display version was simplified with mapshaper (topology-preserving).
validation: Automated checks at build: 69 valid polygons; no overlaps above 1 km² after the documented fix; gap against the national land outline below 200 km² (coastline differences). Boundaries have not been checked against official legal texts or survey data.
limitations: Community-mapped boundaries: not an official, legal or cadastral delineation. Positional accuracy varies, particularly for wilayas 59–69 created in 2026.

Transition period: under Loi n° 26-06 the former (mother) wilayas hand over powers to the new wilayas by 31 December 2026 at the latest; statistics published during the transition may still use 48 or 58 units.
Wilaya code 63 (El Aricha) has no ISO 3166-2 tag in OSM at snapshot time; the field is left empty rather than inferred.
The simplified display file is for web maps only; use the full-detail file for analysis.
Computed areas depend on the polygon detail and projection and will differ from official area figures.
algeria_notes: Algeria moved from 48 to 58 wilayas (Loi n° 19-12, 2019; names by Décret n° 21-117, 2021) and to 69 wilayas (Loi n° 26-06, 2026). Other open boundary sets checked by AEO (geoBoundaries, OCHA COD-AB, GADM) still show 48 wilayas. Check which configuration your statistics use before joining tables to polygons.

verification.notes: Processing log and fixes in PROVENANCE.json. Legal references verified in Journal Officiel PDFs (see research/wilaya_geography.md).
